question: The person rejected the preview rewrite and wants all features fully functional end to end. Given the Open button serves a static copy with no server and the WASM toolchain is unavailable, what is the best way to deliver real functionality?
probes: Read feed.json history: repeated preview complaints and 'all features 1:1 fully rewritten with optimizations'
Check toolchain: no rustup, no wasm32 target, no wasm-bindgen CLI
Check bun cache: unpdf (pdfjs) available for real browser PDF parsing
resolution: Decided and built: the Rust server remains the full shared-data engine, and the browser app now also parses statements for real using the project's own BPI/UnionBank logic over unpdf (pdfjs). The Open/static install is therefore fully functional end to end — real PDF rows, categorisation, de-duplication, password handling and reconciliation — with no generated sample data and no preview-only copy. WASM was ruled out because this environment has no rustup, no wasm32 target and no wasm-bindgen CLI. Verified: real example PDF parses to 2 correct transactions, full local flow works (register, upload, summary, duplicate rejection), web build, cargo build/test and rebuild_check all pass.
